若 packet.continuation.scope=calendar，只处理日历：decisions=[]，保留当前 archiveTitle，不修改新闻、tracking、期号或窗口。按 pinned pages 的完整身份提交 calendarReview 和已核实 upcoming/removeUpcomingIds；部分核验仍显式 deferred，GitHub 保留队列重试。使用同一期单 inbox，不与新闻组成 bundle。
若 editorialInput.calendarWork 存在，upcomingDiscovery 只是预览；必须按 calendarWork.pages 中的 blobSha 读取完整分页（automation/state 分支 automation/batches/<edition-id>/<name>）。calendarReview.pages 对每个 blobSha、calendarReview.platforms 对 PC/PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo 各给一个 key/status/reason；status 只能 reviewed 或 deferred，reason 记录实际核验或具体阻塞。未读完不能声称 reviewed；延期必须显式保留。分页只提供日历线索，采用前仍须打开官方详情核验。
发布会条目须用coveredFactIds登记正文或简讯实际覆盖的showcaseFacts；同一页面、同一游戏不等于全部事实已覆盖。只有存在会改变正文事实边界的实质证据缺口才继续needs_review，不因热度或预算排除，也不要把needs_review当作默认保守选项。
输出 contractVersion=2。你是游戏行业简报编辑；事件事实仅来自已打开的 packet 证据。对 packages 和 trackingQueue 每个 eventKey 恰好给一个 include/exclude/needs_review。needs_review 必须 tracking=true；跟踪项无新证据也须明确继续或关闭，关闭时 tracking=false 且 reason 写依据。
从 automation/status/<edition-id>.json 原样复制 packet.blobSha 到 packetBlobSha；不得使用可变分支 HEAD。publishability=requires_subject_identity 只能 exclude/needs_review，不得从标题虚构 titleKey/titleEn。
若 packet.continuation.scope=news，这是受信的同一期有界续接包：只处理本包 packages/trackingQueue，保留已发布正文、标题、头条和 issue/window，不提交 upcoming 变更，不添加 showcaseRefs、其他批次或窗口外事实。若 scope=showcase，严格按 scoped announcement/fact 身份补齐，不把普通新闻混入，也不因部分材料或 Highlights 声称完整。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。
证据门槛按最终 factStatus 判断，不按来源数量机械升级：official 要求已打开一手来源；单一已打开、注册为 media 的可信媒体，只要主体、窗口和核心事实清楚，就可以 media_report 发布，不得仅因“只有一家媒体”或 readiness=single-media 而 needs_review；可信媒体明确转述可识别的官方公告、采访或发言时，可以 media_relay_official，verification 写清转述链。multi_source_verified 才要求两家独立可靠来源。readiness 只描述证据组成，不是发布资格。未确认但具有新闻价值且来源边界清楚的内容可进 rumors，factStatus=unconfirmed、tracking=true，并在标题摘要保留不确定性；只有主体身份未解、来源互相冲突、固定窗口无法确认、动态聚合数据缺少所需快照等实质阻塞才使用 needs_review。A级也不豁免时间/来源要求。中英文新闻标题和archiveTitle须自带明确的游戏、公司或人物主语，离开上方主体栏仍能独立理解。中文直述具体事实，verification 说明证据边界，不用宣传套话。
每个 include 决定必须填写完整 sharedFactFrame，作为两种语言共用的事实边界；subjectTitleKey/platforms 必须与最终 Canonical 决定一致，日期、时刻、数字、人物机构、版本专名只能来自所选证据，不得新增。

packages.headline: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School comes to PS5 on November 5

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Discover a fully explorable and puzzling open-world campus that rewards curiosity
Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School comes to PS5 on November 5
Hello Puzzlers and PlayStation fans! The team at Coin Crew Games is excited to share that Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School will be coming to PS5 on November 5. To celebrate, we are sharing some deep-dive information about what players can expect in this sequel that expands the first game from a more linear narrative to a whole new open-world campus. Of course, you can also expect couch or online co-op play available from the get go between the full campus, story and all of its puzzles.
Whether you played the first game or not, Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School is open to everyone and represents a more fully-realized campus experience. We want the Academy to feel like a place players can get lost in, filled with characters, quests, secrets, and plenty of reasons to explore between escapes.
The Headmaster’s Tower was one of the first spaces we worked on when designing the updated visuals in Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School and it inspired the most discussion about how to make a space feel truly “Academic” and further push the worldbuilding before expanding on each location’s unique identities. Players will get a sense of the Academy’s history more than ever with this area while still discovering plenty of playful and strange puzzles.
This also led us back to the Headmaster’s Office, which was the setting of our very first escape in the original Escape Academy. The location became our visual target as we began leveling up the art style for Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School. We hope players will see how we pushed the visual identity of the Academy further while still making it recognizable to returning players.
From concepts to being fully realized, the Humanities Campus has seen the most deviation from the first entry’s 2D map layout. It was a fun challenge designing this game to be more open world as we went through a lot of iteration with this area. At first, things felt too open, and we eventually found lots of new ways for players to engage with the area like interactable landmarks, side quests and escapes.
We also hid a lot of keyhole embellishments all around the Academy, see if you can find them all.
That’s all for today’s lesson. The team and I are thrilled to be bringing Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School back to PlayStation fans around the world when the game launches for PlayStation 5 on November 5. We can’t wait for players to explore the Academy, uncover its secrets, meet new and returning faces, and discover that there’s much more to this school than meets the eye.
Our campus is broken up into several distinct sections, each filled to the brim with quests and puzzles for you to encounter throughout the journey. For this lesson, we’re sharing new details on the Headmaster’s Tower and Humanities Campus, which makes a more expanded return from the first game after [spoiler!] Quanty burned down the library in the first game.

packages.headline: Introducing XBOX LABS

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
This message was just sent to Team XBOX employees globally. Team, The first video games emerged some 75 years ago. In the time since, there have been booms and busts, but every year there are more great games to play, more devices to play them, and best of all, more people than ever playing. That […]
This message was just sent to Team XBOX employees globally.
The first video games emerged some 75 years ago. In the time since, there have been booms and busts, but every year there are more great games to play, more devices to play them, and best of all, more people than ever playing. That growth helped make XBOX what it is today, and we’ve helped shape the industry in return, from bringing hard drives to consoles and online gaming through Xbox Live to Game Pass and cloud gaming, alongside franchises that have brought millions of people together.
These experiments challenge long-held assumptions about our industry: the tether between software and hardware, the boundary between creation and play, and how people discover and experience games. While it is hard to predict the future of gaming, it is easy to see the possibilities in making great games easier to access, giving old games new life and allowing more players to become creators and co-creators. These are unmistakably good outcomes for players, even when (and sometimes because) they challenge our existing business models. To explore these possibilities, I’ve asked Scott to stand-up XBOX LABS , a small group of game makers, engineers and scientists whose job is to turn emerging ideas into things our players and developers can experience. We’ll build in the open, learn from what people do, and measure success by whether more people are playing and creating.
I think XBOX has an important role to play here. Coding became the first major workload for agents because they can write, run, and test software. Games share many of those same properties, and people spend more than 72 billion hours a year playing XBOX games, roughly five times the estimated time spent writing code worldwide. We’ve spent 25 years learning how to make great games, and I want our game makers to help shape what these new technologies make possible. As we learn, we’ll share the tools we build with developers across the industry, just as we always have.
Our priorities aren’t changing. We remain committed to the 4Cs, to making great games, to our hardware and to being responsible stewards of IP and the communities built around it. LABS gives us a way to explore new technology without abandoning the work already underway.
In recent weeks, we’ve seen games rapidly decompiled and rebuilt to run on hardware they were never originally designed to support. Windows PC builds have been translated to run on Apple Silicon or ported to run inside a browser through WebAssembly and WebGPU, the latter now approaching 90% global browser support. Perhaps more surprisingly, we’ve seen many of the biggest games in the world have been remixed into the source code of another.

Just Dance: Decades of Hits Out Now – Choreography Director Talks About A Musical Journey Through Dance
Just Dance: Decades of Hits is out now for XBOX Series X|S, bringing the hottest hits from different musical eras to one dance floor. Perfect for any game night or party, up to six people can dance locally, using their phones as controllers. Those grooving solo can enjoy the new Adventure mode and its narrative journey, in which you follow Dr. Gigavolt’s daughter Lyra in a playful adventure across six themed worlds to rescue her father. However you play, with hits for every generation from the ’70s to present day, there’s something for everyone.
Some of the songs included in Just Dance: Decades of Hits are:
The music in Just Dance: Decades of Hits is designed to take players on a musical journey through the generations through dance. We spoke to Choreography Director Estelle Manas, who gave insights on how music and choreography have evolved over the years and how Just Dance: Decades of Hits takes you on a journey through movement as well as song.
How has dance and choreography evolved through the decades, from the ’70s to now?
Estelle Manas : What’s fascinating about exploring several decades is seeing just how much dance reflects its era.
In the ’70s, you find a lot of simple movements that anyone can easily reproduce while adding their own personal touch. In a rather festive, even flamboyant spirit, it’s not about perfection, but rather about style and groove.
In the ’80s, dance became an integral part of the musical universe because it was everywhere – on TV shows, in music videos, at concerts. With the arrival of hip-hop and pop, dance styles really asserted themselves and aligned with their associated musical genres. You can clearly see the differences in energy and movement quality; everyone expressed their personality through dance. Through her moves, Madonna expressed a female freedom that broke the rules. In “Jump,” we wanted to capture the extravagant and sexy side of rockstars.

packages.headline: Valor Mortis: Tips and Tricks to Survive the Crimson Plague

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
In Valor Mortis, you play William, a young Englishman disillusioned with the monarchy who joins Napoleon's cause, drawn by the promise of a unified Europe. He dies for that ideal — and you’ll need every tool at your disposal to survive what follows in Valor Mortis, available today with Game Pass.
Valor Mortis: Tips and Tricks to Survive the Crimson Plague
The Crimson Plague is ravaging Europe. Scattered across every level, echoes of the fallen and journal pages reveal the army’s secrets and the horrors of the plague. In Valor Mortis , you play William, a young Englishman disillusioned with the monarchy who joins Napoleon’s cause, drawn by the promise of a unified Europe. He dies for that ideal — and you’ll need every tool at your disposal to survive what follows in Valor Mortis , available today for XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, Game Pass, and with support for XBOX Play Anywhere. Before you lead William into battle, the team at One More Level wants to share how its combat really works, and a few things we hope you will go looking for.
Valor Mortis is a soulslike, but its systems are built to feed each other. Your blade breaks posture. Your firearms hit weak points. Hitting weak points refills your nephtoglobin (nephto), and killing enemies often drops ammo. Once that loop clicks, you are always one move away from your next advantage.
Valor Mortis rewards you for exploring, like a metroidvania. Abilities you unlock later open up areas you have already visited. Later levels open into combat arenas with fights across multiple heights, and villages are full of shortcuts and alternate paths.
Some of the most powerful enemies in Valor Mortis are also the best hidden. Optional mini-bosses wait in the corners of its interconnected levels for players curious enough to look. You never know what you will discover, or what kind of trouble you will find.
Valor Mortis is available today for XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, Game Pass, and with support for XBOX Play Anywhere. We can’t wait to see the builds you create and the secrets you uncover.
Change Your Playstyle with Ambers
Ambers are where your build gets personal. Some simply make you stronger, but the best ones change how the game plays. Slot them in when you visit a lantern. The more you level William, the more Ambers you can equip, so use catalyst clots from your inventory to push past the next level threshold.

Warframe Sets Course for a Distant Star System in Epoch Operation: Taubound
Join millions of players around the world for a one-time community event arriving October 15.
Community is the nexus of everything we do and every choice we make as Warframe developers. We create games with players, not just for players, and build trust over time through actions that demonstrate we listen. Our players around the world in our XBOX community are a monumental part of that family portrait; they help us make Warframe a better experience for everyone, and they deliver the critical feedback we need to ensure Warframe remains a safe, enjoyable space to spend a little time with friends and family online. To this day, I still pull out my XBOX 360 controller for our live TennoCon demos — it’s one of my favorite peripherals of all time.
Since Warframe debuted on XBOX One in 2014, we’ve thrived on stories and reports from our welcoming community of players across two generations of XBOX. In that time, we’ve brought them parity in content across platforms, introduced new ways to engage with a more global community with the introduction of cross-play and cross-save, and have dedicated platform-specific resources for players on XBOX to communicate with us directly.
From Warframe’s humble beginnings, we’ve teased the far-future narrative of Tau, a distant Star System shrouded in mystery. This year, we’re finally going together, and our community of XBOX players can help us get there. Instead, Deep Dish Dungeon asks you to build a deeper connection with the dungeon, learn its history, understand its mysteries, and slowly become part of its world. sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
God of War Laufey is the next big game to get a collector box without the game itself.
$150 God of War Laufey Collector Box Revealed, No Game Included
Following in the footsteps of GTA 6, God of War Laufey is the next big game to get a collector box without the game itself.
Sony has revealed the collector box for God of War Laufey, which costs $150 and includes a nice statue of Faye. Unfortunately it does not include a steelbook with a disc copy of the game, or any copy of the game, physically or digitally. Preorders open today at 10am PT through PlayStation Direct, and stock is limited, Sony warned. You can view a full breakdown of the box's items below.
God of War Laufey Collector Box contents:
Predictably, a lot of people are drawing comparisons to the game-less GTA 6 collector's box . However, some may be a bit more accepting of the value God of War is offering here. GTA 6's box includes a bunch of Vice City-themed merch, such as a pair of sunglasses, a hat, and a figure of a cartoon gator named Macca. It also costs a whopping $400, which is tough to swallow.
Many were critical of the fact that GTA 6's box didn't include a statue of Jason and Lucia , in addition to feeling like the box could've been cheaper if it didn't include certain items. So, God of War Laufey may not be as egregious to some fans given it is a smaller box with a statue of the protagonist. Still, it does feel a bit lacking compared to previous God of War collector's editions.
God of War Ragnarok's collector's edition included Thor's hammer, a steelbook (no game disc, though), DLC, a code for PS4 and PS5 copies of the game, and a handful of other trinkets. God of War 2018's collector's edition included a statue of Kratos and Atreus, a steelbook with a disc, a physical map, a litograph, and two small figures of Brok and Sindri, in addition to a bunch of digital content.
While this is likely supposed to be an add-on for people who are already planning on buying the game, it's disappointing that God of War Laufey's box doesn't at least include a complimentary upgrade to the game's digital deluxe edition, which includes special armor and weapons in the full game.

iPhone/iPad向けのアプリケーション開発に変革がやってきている。現在iPadでは、対応しているアプリでユーザーが自由にアプリの表示サイズを変更できる。これにはアスペクト比の変更も含まれる。さらにiOS 27ではMac上でミラーリングした際に、iPhoneでもアプリの表示サイズを変更できる。また、10月23日には折りたたみ型のiPhone Duoが発売予定。アプリの更新を続けたい開発者たちはさまざまなディスプレイサイズに対応しなければならず、iOS/iPadOS 27向けのSDKによるビルドが必須となる2027年4月までにこの問題に対処する必要がある。アプリ開発者間でもじわじわと 話題 になりつつあるようだ。
デバイス・OSの更新によって、これまでの規格が通用しなくなるiOS/iPadOS向けアプリ開発で何をしなければならないのか。弊誌では実際にUnityを利用してiPhone/iPad向けのシューティングゲーム『TIME LOCKER』を手がけている開発者のOtsuka氏に話をうかがうことができた。本稿では、iOS/iPadOSの進化に伴う、アプリ開発者側の対応の実態をお届けする。
まずはiPadOSの変更について説明していこう。Appleは2025年6月にiPadOS 26を発表。同年9月に配信した。「iPadOS史上最大のリリース」と謳われたiPadOS 26では新たなウィンドウシステムが導入された。これまでiPadではフルスクリーン表示をベースに2つのアプリを並べるSplit Viewなどを実装してきたが、本OSからはMacと同じようにアプリケーションを自由なウィンドウサイズで表示し、ユーザーの好みの配置を行えるようになったのだ。

Rockstar's Multi-Million Dollar Miami Takeover Continues to Expand Ahead of GTA 6 Launch, Despite Protests from Some Officials
Rockstar Games is continuing to ramp up GTA 6's massive marketing with a Vice City blimp, NFL promos, and much more, despite protests from some Miami officials.
For the last two months, Rockstar has been setting up marketing for what will likely be one of the biggest, if not the biggest, releases in entertainment history. It kicked things off with a massive gameplay reveal on Netflix , followed by a blitz of merch and add-ons such as an album featuring original music created for GTA 6 . Now, Rockstar is taking over the real world to help spread the word of what's to come on November 19.
Rockstar is currently focusing marketing on the city of Miami. GTA 6 takes place in a fictional version of Miami known as Vice City, so Rockstar is utilizing the city for a lot of its advertising, which has led to friction between city officials. Some are all for it, as they hope it attracts more tourism and generates increased revenue. Others, however, are strongly opposed and have been for weeks.
According to The Miamian, County Commissioner René Garcia has expressed displeasure over the marketing campaign for GTA 6 in Miami, reporting he's "really uncomfortable with this whole thing." Specifically, Garcia doesn't like that the city is collaborating with a "game that's depicting Miami like a crime haven; Miami like a murder capital.”
Garcia and other officials are reportedly attempting to squash negotiations with Rockstar to expand its marketing efforts for GTA 6 in the city, which allegedly include ads at Miami International Airport and a $4 million transformation of Miami Beach. The rollout was expected to begin as soon as October 15, but Miami journalist Joel Franco stated that an unnamed official doubts that deals will be finalized in time.
In September, Rockstar paid just shy of $1 million to install a massive, glowing "Welcome to Vice City" sign on top of the Miami Heat's arena, the Kaseya Center . The arena will also be home to an unprecedented NBA game sponsored by Rockstar Games. On November 18, the Miami Heat will play a regular season game against the Milwaukee Bucks on a Vice City-themed court with never-before-seen jerseys inspired by GTA 6 . The arena will also be selling Vice City merch, with Rockstar and the NBA labeling the event as a "night in Vice City."
Over the weekend, Miami's Hard Rock Stadium, the home of the Miami Dolphins, was covered in GTA 6 ads. The stadium's jumbotron featured ads for the game, promoting its release date. During touchdowns, the screen also had a GTA 6-themed animation with text that read "In for VI," in reference to the team scoring six points.

packages.headline: ‘I Got That Completely Wrong’ — Dan Houser Considers Rockstar’s Max Payne 3 a Failure

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
‘I got that completely wrong’ — Dan Houser explains why he thinks Rockstar’s Max Payne 3 ‘failed’.
‘I Got That Completely Wrong’ — Dan Houser Considers Rockstar’s Max Payne 3 a Failure
Max Payne and its sequel, Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne, are two of the most genre-defining third-person shooters ever made. They propelled Finnish developer Remedy Entertainment into the spotlight as one of the most exciting studios making games. So, it was also going to be a challenge for another developer to pick up the third part of that trilogy. If you have the likes of Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption under your belt, though, you might just fancy your chances.
That’s what former Rockstar VP and writer of Max Payne 3, Dan Houser, thought, and while enjoying the process of making it, he now admits that it didn’t quite hit the mark. Despite being well-received critically, the 2012 game underperformed commercially, and wasn’t a huge hit with players. While Max Payne 3 is a great shooter in its own right, some questioned whether it tonally fit with its heavily noir-influenced predecessors, instead trading in the gloomy, introspective weirdness of Remedy’s New York set games for a more high-octane, colourful, all-action approach.
“It was a linear game, so it was a little different from writing an open-world game, a little more structured,” Houser told IGN as part of our IGN30 Icons Series. “I really enjoyed that as an experience. I loved what we did design-wise, the way the game didn't have loads, the way it felt like a 12-hour movie, some of the visual stuff we did with words on screen. I felt we were creating a really cool digital noir experience, and the consensus at the time was that people hated it.
“So I got that completely wrong,” Houser admitted. “I know Sam Lake [creator of Max Payne] well, and he's a very good guy and really talented. I thought we'd done a good job of doing another Max Payne game. Some people liked it; lots didn't. So we got it wrong, or I got it wrong. I failed. My bit was not a success. The game is beautifully made, and it wasn't as successful as it should have been. So I would say a large amount of that failure was on me as one of the people making the decisions and also as the writer, when people really missed his writing.”
Max Payne 3 is certainly different in tone to what came before it, but I still hold a lot of love for it. Max Payne 2 remains one of my favourite games to this day due to the storytelling housed in its murky world, but there’s no denying that Rockstar brought something new and flashy to the table almost a decade later when taking the character to Brazil.
That bullet time still feels as sweet as ever to trigger, though, and if that level of polish can be brought over to Remedy’s upcoming remakes of the first two in the trilogy, then they can’t come soon enough. We last heard about the project over a year ago, when the studio revealed that it was in “full production” and that the "collaboration with Rockstar Games remains close and productive."
Of course, Rockstar currently has its plate very much full with the imminent launch of GTA 6 on November 19. For more on GTA 6, you can read our full interview with Rockstar co-studio head Rob Nelson , how the game will tackle the current political climate , and why Dan Houser says he won’t be playing it .

packages.headline: “AAA級のマインスイーパー”『Triple-A Minesweeper』が皮肉を振り撒き反響呼ぶ。「大型ゲームあるある」な起動直後にブランドロゴ連発、プレイは黄色いガイドに従うだけ

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
Mike Lacher氏は10月7日、『Triple-A Minesweeper』を公開した。本作はブラウザから無料で遊ぶことができる。“AAA規模の大型マインスイーパー”というコンセプトで開発された本作に込められた風刺に反響が寄せられている。
“AAA級のマインスイーパー”『Triple-A Minesweeper』が皮肉を振り撒き反響呼ぶ。「大型ゲームあるある」な起動直後にブランドロゴ連発、プレイは黄色いガイドに従うだけ
『Triple-A Minesweeper』のゲームプレイ自体は一般的なマインスイーパーと同じだ。地雷が埋め込まれていると思われるマス目を避けて、地雷の置かれていないマスをすべて開けることを目指す。ただし、本作には「もし大予算でマインスイーパーをリブートしたら」というコンセプトが加えられている。
ブラウザ上でゲームを起動してまず目に飛び込むのは、見慣れたマインスイーパーのゲーム画面ではなく、サードパーティ製ソフトウェアの紹介ロゴだ。「Unreal Engine」や「NVIDIA」、さらには「Bink Video」「Wwise」といったお馴染みの企業やソフトウェアのロゴが十数秒にわたって次々と表示される。それらをひと通り見せつけられたところで、ようやく画面いっぱいに「Minesweeper」のタイトルが映し出される。
そんな同氏が新たな風刺として手がけたのが『Triple-A Minesweeper』だ。わずか数分のゲームプレイのなかで、「親切過ぎるガイド」や「ゲーム起動時に長々と見せつけられるロゴ」といった、“AAAタイトルあるある”をユーモラスに表現している。
『 Triple-A Minesweeper 』はブラウザ向けに無料公開中だ。なお、環境によっては一部の演出がカットされる場合がある様子なので、皮肉が足りない場合は別のブラウザを試すなどしてみてほしい。

packages.headline: “統計に基づくリアル人生”シミュレーター『80億分の1』大流行中。生まれはガチャで生き方は自分次第、生々しい人生見守りブーム

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
Jin Hwi-eus氏は10月5日、人生シミュレーター『80億分の1』をリリースした。SNS上で大きな話題を呼んでいる。
“統計に基づくリアル人生”シミュレーター『80億分の1』大流行中。生まれはガチャで生き方は自分次第、生々しい人生見守りブーム
デベロッパーのJin Hwi-eus氏は10月5日、人生シミュレーター 『80億分の1』 をリリースした。本作はSNS上で話題となっており、多くのプレイヤーがもう1人の自分の人生について投稿している。
『80億分の1』は、統計データに基づいた人生シミュレーションゲームである。プレイヤーは世界のどこかの誰かとして、生を受けることになる。どこの国で生まれるかはわからず、どんな家庭の子となるかもわからない。そうした未知の要素は統計データに基づいてランダムに決定される。進路選択や就職、病気や事故、学校でのいじめ、家族の死など、さまざまなことを体験しながら、もう1人の自分の人生を見つめるのだ。
そんな本作がSNS上でさっそく話題になっている。本作の日本語版ハッシュタグである「#80億分の1」には、多くのプレイヤーによる“もう1つの人生”が投稿されている。90歳以上まで長生きして多くの家族に恵まれながら天寿を全うする人もいれば、赤ん坊のときに大きな病気で亡くなる人もいる。似た人生はあっても、同じ人生はどこにもない。
ゲームを開始する際には、生まれる世界と、生まれる国の決め方、ひとつの人生の長さを選択する。設定に基づいて人生がスタートすることになるが、世界のどこで生まれるかや、両親がどんな人か、家庭の裕福さなどはいっさい選ぶことができない。こうした要素は統計データに基づいて運任せで決まるのだ。

packages.headline: 『エースコンバット8』予約特典の『エースコンバット・ゼロ』Steam版、“単独起動できる”アプリ追加決定。140GB超の『8』をインストールせずに遊べる

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
バンダイナムコエンターテインメントは10月13日、『エースコンバット8』Steam版の予約特典について、『エースコンバット・ゼロ』単体のアプリケーションとして配信できる見通しになったと告知した。
『エースコンバット8』予約特典の『エースコンバット・ゼロ』Steam版、“単独起動できる”アプリ追加決定。140GB超の『8』をインストールせずに遊べる
バンダイナムコエンターテインメントは10月13日、『エースコンバット8 WINGS OF THEVE（ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE、以下エースコンバット8）』Steam版の特典について、『 エースコンバット・ゼロ（ACE COMBAT ZERO） 』単体のアプリケーションとして配信できる見通しになったと告知した。現行の『エースコンバット8』本体の起動時に選択してプレイする以外に、単体アプリケーション版も追加で提供となるようだ。あくまで予約特典の所有者向けの対応であり、新たに『エースコンバット・ゼロ』を入手できるようになるものではない点も強調されている。
『エースコンバット8』は、『エースコンバット』シリーズ30周年記念となる、ドラマティックフライトシューティングゲームである。同作でプレイヤーはエースパイロットとして、戦闘機を操作。空を自由に飛び回り、敵の戦闘機などとの戦いを繰り広げていく。本作ではリアルな空を追求したグラフィックで、難局を突破する爽快感などが展開。救難ボートをさまよっているところを旧式空母に拾われ、エースとして活躍していくストーリーも特徴だろう。
現在予約特典である『エースコンバット・ゼロ』Steam版では、『エースコンバット8』起動時に表示される起動オプションより、『エースコンバット・ゼロ』を選択して遊ぶ形式となっている。『エースコンバット8』本体をインストールすると一緒にインストールされる形式となっており、単体でのインストールなどはできないわけだ。『エースコンバット8』は約140GBの大容量タイトルであり、『エースコンバット・ゼロ』だけをインストールしてプレイできないこともあってか、不満の声もみられた。
今回の告知 では、Steam上で『エースコンバット・ゼロ』を単体アプリケーションとして配信できる見通しになったと発表された。現行の『エースコンバット8』本編を起動してプレイする『エースコンバット・ゼロ』に加えて、単体アプリケーション版の『エースコンバット・ゼロ』も利用できる状態になるという。配信に向けた最終的な確認および動作確認が進められているそうだ。なおSteamクラウドによって、両バージョン間でのセーブデータ共有もできるという。具体的な配信日程などは明かされていないものの、単体での提供もおこなわれることとなったわけだ。なお本対応は、プレオーダー特典として『エースコンバット・ゼロ』を入手しているプレイヤー向けの対応となる。『エースコンバット8』の不具合については、近日中に不具合の一部修正などを含むアップデートが予定されている。
『 エースコンバット8 』は、PS5/XBOX Series X|S/PC（Steam）向けに発売中。『エースコンバット・ゼロ』Steam版は、単体版も提供予定だ。
『エースコンバット8』予約特典の『エースコンバット・ゼロ』Steam版、“単独起動できる”アプリ追加決定。140GB超の『8』をインストールせずに遊べる
同作は2026年10月にリリース。記事執筆時点ではSteamのユーザーレビュー1万4874件中82％の好評を得てステータス「非常に好評」となっている。また同作には、プレオーダー特典として2006年にPS2用として発売された『エースコンバット・ゼロ』が付属。前作『ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN』に『ACE COMBAT 5: THE UNSUNG WAR』などが予約特典として付属したのと同様、本作を予約すると人気のある『エースコンバット・ゼロ』の移植版がもらえるようになっていた。

packages.headline: 『ファイナルファンタジーX/X-2 HD リマスター』Steam版、7年ぶりにひっそりアプデ。悪名高い“いいところで画面が緑一色”バグがとうとう修正か

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
スクウェア・エニックスは10月1日、Steam版『ファイナルファンタジーX/X-2 HD リマスター』向けに7年ぶりのアップデートを配信した。
『ファイナルファンタジーX/X-2 HD リマスター』Steam版、7年ぶりにひっそりアプデ。悪名高い“いいところで画面が緑一色”バグがとうとう修正か
スクウェア・エニックスは10月1日、Steam版『ファイナルファンタジーX/X-2 HD リマスター』（以下、FFX/X-2リマスター）向けに7年ぶりのアップデートを配信した。Steamニュースのみで発表されており、アップデート内容は「様々な不具合を修正しました」の一文のみ。詳細は伏せられているものの、長年に渡って報告されてきた「グリーンスクリーンバグ」が修正されたようだ。
『FFX/X-2リマスター』は、PS2向けに発売された『ファイナルファンタジーX』と『ファイナルファンタジーX-2』の2作品が1つになったHDリマスター版だ。対応プラットフォームは、PC（Steam）/PS4/XBOX One/Nintendo Switch/Nintendo Switch 2。オリジナル版は2001年および2003年に発売。特に『ファイナルファンタジーX』は、異世界に迷い込んだ主人公ティーダと召喚士ユウナとの切ない恋、父親ジェクトとの親子愛、災厄「シン」を巡る緻密な伏線といった物語やそれを彩る音楽などが高く評価され、ゲーム史に残る名作としてシリーズ屈指の人気を誇っている。両作の合計販売本数は2000万本を突破している。
2013年にはPS3およびPS Vita向けのHDリマスターが発売。その後各プラットフォーム向けにも順次展開された。Steam版は2016年に発売され、高速モードや戦闘強化、エンカウント調整、すべてのアイテムやアビリティを取得といったブースト機能が追加されている。なお、今年7月に配信されたNintendo Switch 2版にも同様のブースト機能が追加されており、それまではSteam版のみの機能となっていた。
🌊✨━━━━━━━━━━✨🌊 『ファイナルファンタジーX』 🎊25周年🎊 🌊✨━━━━━━━━━━✨🌊 25年前の今日、 #FF10 が発売されたクポ！ 記念にスペシャルムービーをお届けクポ〜🎬✨ 25周年特設ページ🔗 https://t.co/YN2NPwrsOU #FFX25th pic.twitter.com/siDqKyFM8C
なお、先述したとおり、『FFX/X-2リマスター』は今年7月にNintendo Switch 2版が発売された。『ファイナルファンタジーX』は発売から25周年を迎えており、さまざまな施策も展開。このタイミングでSteam版がアップデートされた背景にあるのかもしれない。
ちなみに10月22日に発売される『ファイナルファンタジー レゾナンス』には、異なる世界の英雄の力を借りるビジョンとして本作の主人公ティーダが登場。入手する際には登場作品のBGMや名場面も流れるという。また、モバイル向けに今年配信された『ディシディア デュエルム ファイナルファンタジー』には、恒常キャラクターとしてリュックが参戦しているほか、期間限定でティーダも参戦。オリジナルストーリーも描かれ、過去シーズンのストーリーは無制限に視聴可能だ。アップデートされた『FFX/X-2リマスター』をプレイ後に、それぞれの作品でキャラクターたちの活躍を見届けるのもいいだろう。
